property.title: Single Family Residence In Bay Head
property.description: Rare true double lot on coveted East Avenue, anchored in the heart of Bay Head's Gold Coast between Chadwick and Johnson Street beaches. Land is the new luxury, and this exceptional property offers the privacy and flexibility.  This timeless Dutch Colonial, built in 1995, was thoughtfully designed for gracious entertaining and large gatherings, offering a traditional coastal lifestyle in one of the most beloved locations on the barrier island. Perfectly positioned for effortless beach access and town living, the double lot creates estate-like privacy with endless possibilities for future enjoyment. A classic home on extraordinary land.
